Iran President Signals Readiness for Talks if US Returns to Deal

Iranian President Ebrahim Raisi has indicated Iran's willingness to reciprocate if the United States honors a June Memorandum of Understanding (MoU). Raisi stated that Iran is ready to resume peace talks and reciprocate if the US returns to the interim peace deal. This statement comes amid high-stakes talks involving the UN chief. The specific terms of the June MoU and the 'glaring issue' left unaddressed in the UN chief's talks were not detailed in the provided coverage.
